response.overview: An introspective coming-of-age drama that explores adolescence, memory, father-absence, and the quiet uncertainty of growing up through the lens of liminal spaces and nostalgia. Set between abandoned places, empty homes, and transitional spaces, the story follows a teenager confronting change, grief, and the fear of moving forward while preparing to leave behind the life he once knew. At its core, the film reflects on identity, longing, and the emotional weight of growing up without a father figure.
response.title: Neo Was Here
